description: eventing-handler-advancedLookupInOp.md's OnUpdate signature is `OnUpdate(doc, meta, xattrs)` - a third parameter never used in the handler body and inconsistent with every other OnUpdate signature in the batch, which take exactly two arguments (doc, meta). Likely a copy-paste artifact from the nearby `{"xattrs": false}` binding option. Also inconsistent with the registry's own eventing:on-update-handler description, which documents a two-argument signature.
